about: a blocking HTTP call inside an async function

answer.title: Blocking requests.get inside an async function
answer.description: requests.get blocks the event loop for the whole HTTP round trip, so every other request handled by this worker waits up to 5 seconds while one profile loads.
answer.suggestion: Use an async client: async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=5) as client: response = await client.get(url).
